tools.description: Grants one entitlement to a customer for a duration or until an end time, citing a product mapped to the application, and records the reason and the acting key in the audit trail. The customer's entitlements are recomputed and the application's webhook is notified. Use get_customer first to see grant_options. Requires a key with write access.

application_id.description: The application whose webhook receives the entitlement change.

customer_id.description: The internal customer id. A merged customer's grant is stored on its canonical customer.

duration_days.description: Grant length in days from now, from 1 to 3660. Give either duration_days or ends_at.

ends_at.description: Absolute RFC 3339 end time in the future, at most 3660 days ahead. Give either duration_days or ends_at.

entitlement_id.description: The entitlement to grant. The product must grant it; get_customer lists valid pairs in grant_options.

idempotency_key.description: A key unique to this grant in the project, at most 200 characters. Repeating the call with the same key and arguments returns the stored grant as a replay; the same key with other arguments fails with conflict.

product_id.description: The product the grant cites. It must not be a consumable and must be mapped to a store product of the application.

project_id.description: The project id. An agent key may only name its own project.

reason.description: Why the grant is made, for example a support ticket. One line, 1 to 500 characters, stored in the audit trail.

tools.name: create_manual_grant
tools.title: Create manual grant

tools.description: Returns one customer's identity, merged members and aliases, current entitlements with the access source each one cites, manual grants, and a bounded purchase and delivery timeline. Use it to explain why a customer does or does not have an entitlement.

customer_id.description: The internal customer id, for example from search_customers or resolve_customer.

project_id.description: The project id. An agent key may only name its own project.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.title: Get customer

tools.description: Returns one project's 30-day verification activity, revenue availability from imported store reports, applications with credential and webhook coverage, products, recent customers and transactions, queue outcomes, and recent webhook deliveries.

financial_period_end.description: Optional last day (YYYY-MM-DD) of the financial report period used for revenue. Requires financial_period_start.

financial_period_start.description: Optional first day (YYYY-MM-DD) of the financial report period used for revenue. Requires financial_period_end.

project_id.description: The project id. An agent key may only name its own project.

tools.name: get_project_overview
tools.title: Get project overview

tools.description: Reports what is still missing in one project's setup: per application the stored provider credential kinds and revisions, whether a webhook endpoint is stored and its origin, and the store notification path (and the full URL when the server's public URL is configured) to paste into App Store Connect, the Play notifications Pub/Sub push subscription, or AppGallery Connect. It also lists queue failures and recent failed webhook deliveries. Credential payloads and secrets are never returned.

project_id.description: The project id. An agent key may only name its own project.

tools.name: get_setup_status
tools.title: Get setup status

tools.description: Returns subscription health for one project environment over a UTC day window: active, new, renewed, and churned subscriptions, trial conversion where the store records it, a per-product breakdown, and daily active counts.

project_id.description: The project id. An agent key may only name its own project.

window_days.description: UTC day window ending today, from 1 to 90. Defaults to 30.

tools.name: get_subscription_metrics
tools.title: Get subscription metrics

tools.description: Lists one project's imported store financial reports with their period, status, and accepted currency totals per application. Report files and order ids are never returned.

page_size.description: Reports per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

page_token.description: The next_page_token from the previous page.

project_id.description: The project id. An agent key may only name its own project.

tools.name: list_financial_reports
tools.title: List financial reports

tools.description: Lists the projects this API key can read, with application, customer, and product counts. An agent key sees only its own project.

page_size.description: Projects per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

page_token.description: The next_page_token from the previous page.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects

tools.description: Attaches an additional external customer id to a canonical customer and records the acting key in the audit trail, or confirms an alias that already resolves to that customer. An external id that belongs to another customer fails with conflict. Requires a key with write access.

customer_id.description: The canonical internal customer id the alias resolves to.

external_id.description: The additional external customer id. It must not already belong to another customer.

project_id.description: The project id. An agent key may only name its own project.

tools.name: put_customer_alias
tools.title: Put customer alias

tools.description: Creates one entitlement definition, or confirms it when the same id already has the same key. A different key for an existing id fails with conflict; nothing is overwritten. Requires a key with write access.

key.description: The public entitlement key apps check, for example premium.

project_id.description: The project id. An agent key may only name its own project.

tools.name: put_entitlement
tools.title: Put entitlement

tools.description: Creates one product with its kind and the exact set of entitlements it grants, or confirms it when the same id already has the same kind and set. A different kind or set fails with conflict; nothing is overwritten. Requires a key with write access.

entitlement_ids.description: The complete set of entitlement ids the product grants. Each must already exist.

project_id.description: The project id. An agent key may only name its own project.

tools.name: put_product
tools.title: Put product

tools.description: Maps one store product of an application to an internal product, or confirms the identical mapping. A mapping to a different product fails with conflict; nothing is overwritten. Requires a key with write access.

application_id.description: The application the provider product belongs to.

product_id.description: The internal product the store product maps to. It must already exist.

project_id.description: The project id. An agent key may only name its own project.

provider_product_id.description: The product id in the store, for example the App Store product identifier.

tools.name: put_store_product
tools.title: Put store product

tools.description: Resolves an external customer id or alias to the canonical internal customer id in one project.

external_id.description: The external customer id or alias the host application uses.

project_id.description: The project id. An agent key may only name its own project.

tools.name: resolve_customer
tools.title: Resolve customer

tools.description: Ends one manual grant early, records the reason and the acting key in the audit trail, recomputes the customer's entitlements, and notifies the application's webhook. The customer loses access that the grant gave, and a revocation cannot be undone. Revoking a revoked grant returns the stored revocation. Requires a key with write access.

customer_id.description: The customer the grant belongs to, or any customer merged with it.

grant_id.description: The manual grant id (mgr-...), from get_customer.

project_id.description: The project id. An agent key may only name its own project.

reason.description: Why the grant ends early. One line, 1 to 500 characters, stored in the audit trail.

tools.name: revoke_manual_grant
tools.title: Revoke manual grant

tools.description: Finds customers in one project by internal id, external id, alias, or store transaction id, and reports why each matched. Purchase tokens are never searchable.

limit.description: Customers per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 25.

page_token.description: The next_page_token from the previous page of the same query.

project_id.description: The project id. An agent key may only name its own project.

query.description: Customer id, external id, alias, or store transaction id. Exact matches rank first, then prefix matches. Empty lists customers newest first.

tools.name: search_customers
tools.title: Search customers
